issues: 12 张瓦片只是渐变底 + 一枚发光圆点 + 两根白条，看不出是图片/作品，「同一批内容多种看法」的内容本身是空的
换位过程中瓦片贴着平面滑动，阴影始终一样，没有被拿起、放下的物理感
背景是纯 #0a0b10 平涂，暗场没有光向与层次
changes: 瓦片换成像图片的 SVG 程序插画（日落 / 山脊 / 海浪 / 几何四式轮换，沿用原色相序列），viewBox + slice 等效 object-fit: cover，宽高独立插值时不变形不露底
每片底部 scrim 上加标题与张数（首片 Featured 大字），少数片加 FEATURED / NEW 角标；字号固定，不随宽高缩放
换位两段各按段进度 sin 包络抬起：环境阴影变大变虚、接触影变淡、微放大 2.5%，落位即贴回；瓦片补顶部内高光与发丝边
背景改带冷色主光的径向暗场 + 暗角 + soft-light 颗粒；三套布局坐标、smoothstep、段窗口与 0.007 stagger 全部不变
issuesEn: The 12 tiles were just gradients with a glowing dot and two white bars — they didn't read as photos or work, so the "same content, many views" had no content
Tiles slid flat across the plane during re-layout with an unchanging shadow — no sense of being picked up and set down
Flat #0a0b10 background with no light direction or depth
changesEn: Tiles now hold photo-like SVG illustrations (sunset / ridge / waves / geometric, rotating, on the original hue sequence); viewBox + slice behaves like object-fit: cover, so independent width/height interpolation never distorts or exposes the base
A bottom scrim carries a title and photo count on each tile (larger on the featured tile), with FEATURED / NEW tags on a few; type size is fixed and doesn't scale with the box

In both re-layout phases each tile lifts on a sin envelope of its progress — ambient shadow grows and softens, contact shadow fades, 2.5% scale-up — and settles back on landing; tiles gain a top inner highlight and hairline edge
Background is a radial dark field with a cool key light, vignette and soft-light grain; the three layout tables, smoothstep, phase windows and 0.007 stagger are unchanged
